profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Computer Science graduate from the University of Central Florida with hands-on experience in building software solutions across cloud, AI, and full-stack development.

Technical Skills:
Languages: JavaScript, C#, Java, Python, C
Frameworks & Platforms: .NET, Node.js, Flask, React
Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure, AWS, CI/CD
AI & APIs: OpenAI API, Azure AI Services, PyTorch
Databases: SQL (MySQL, SQL Server), MongoDB

I am actively seeking full-time roles in:
Software Engineering / Development
AI-Enabled Applications
Backend / Full-Stack Development

I can be reached at anthonyfetyko@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Worked as back-end software engineer on integrations team for a large Appraisal Management Company.
●	Worked with .NET Core in a micro service architecture to build client integrations to Class Valuation’s order management system.
●	Attended Daily Standup meetings adhering to Scrum development methodology.
positions.insights: ASP.NET, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
●	Worked as software engineer to develop an AI-Powered chatbot for internal IT support using a large language model.
●	Integrated generative AI with Retrieval-Augmented Generation to deliver personalized IT self-help solutions based on user profiles, query history, and knowledge base retrieval.
●	Engineered a scalable, multimodal frontend using React and Atlas Design System, supporting text and document inputs.
●	Engineered a Flask-based backend on Azure, leveraging Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, Blob Storage and Azure AI Search.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Microsoft Azure and +11 skills

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
●	Conducted research using a Neo4j graph database.
●	Used Cypher queries to analyze node features, complex relationships, and datasets.
●	Developed machine learning models to predict company-related insights like label classifications.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
●	Worked as part of QA team on custom software development project for a large Appraisal Management Company managing residential home appraisals.
●	Software we tested a custom web application built with Angular front end and .NET Core back end which was deployed to AWS cloud infrastructure.
●	Attended Daily Standup meetings following Scrum development methodology.
●	Worked with developers and stakeholders to review and agree to acceptance criteria.
●	Reviewed task requirements and assisted in creating test cases.
●	Worked with AWS console to execute lambda functions and review output logs.
●	Responsible for managing deployments to development and test environments using Jenkins.
●	Executed test cases and reported defects in JIRA project management software.
positions.insights: Teamwork, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills
